split_rule: first fold of StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=20260925) over eligible components, stratified by species, then each untested species with >=3 components gets its smallest unlocked development component when it keeps >=2 in development; components with a species seen in <3 components or with recovered/name-fixed images are development-only
fold_rule: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=20260925) over development components
image_cache: RGB, shorter side resized to 448 px with Lanczos when larger (never upscaled), JPEG quality 95, 4:4:4; EXIF orientation not applied
checks: source bytes verified in v3 build and for re-added images; no component, row, or content hash crosses development/test or CV folds
